children: Fox Factory completed the $225 million divestiture of Marucci and applied $200 million in cash proceeds to reduce debt.
Sale of Wheelhouse Holdings (Marucci) closed for $225 million enterprise value.
$200 million cash received at closing was applied in full to reduce borrowings under credit facility.
Net leverage reduced from 3.7x to approximately 2.7x (pro forma as of July 3, 2026).
Annualized interest expense reduced by about $16 million; expected ~$17 million reduction after $25M note is paid.
$25 million unsecured subordinated convertible promissory note matures Dec 31, 2026; conversion option exists if unpaid.
